prompt:
Pikachu, the iconic yellow electric mouse Pokémon, in a classic standing-on-hind-legs pose. CRITICAL COLOUR PALETTE — use ONLY these blocks and respect their roles strictly:
- Body, head, limbs, tail base: SAND (id 6, yellow). This is ~80% of the build.
- Two round red cheek circles on either side of the face: BRICK (id 10).
- Lightning-bolt-shaped tail extending out and up behind the body: built mostly in SAND with a BRICK rectangular accent at the base. The tail should be a recognisable zigzag/bolt silhouette.
- Pointed triangular ears with darker tips: SAND for the main ear, OAK_LOG (id 4, brown) for the very tips (the canonical Pikachu has black tips but OAK_LOG reads dark and is the best available proxy — DO NOT use STONE which would look grey).
- Eyes: STONE (id 3) for the dark eye dots, with a single GLASS (id 11) block highlight in each eye.
- Small black nose and mouth: STONE.

POSE: Standing on hind legs, slight forward lean, head facing the viewer (+Z direction). One front paw raised slightly higher than the other (right arm waving or charging energy). Tail curling out behind and up, terminating in the lightning bolt shape. Ears straight up and tall. Cheek patches clearly visible from the front.

PROPORTIONS: Pikachu is short and round. Body about 1.5× wider than tall in the torso region. Big round head approximately as wide as the torso. Tail roughly as tall as the body. Total height ~30-34 blocks.

The silhouette must be UNMISTAKABLY PIKACHU from any angle. Don't be subtle — pointed ears, round cheek patches in BRICK, and the zigzag tail are the three signature features. Place them prominently.

Use smooth stepped curves (no sharp polygonal edges) to get the round body. Use the full budget.
